Generation Stations
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: Turb-033-r0a
Equipment: Mechanical parts of the turbine
Status: Approved
Issued to: Esna Power Station

This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the mechanical parts of the turbine. The first draft of the document was prepared and field-tested by Eng. Abdelsalam Abdelhamid Metwally at Esna Power Station, reviewed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, approved by Eng. Abdelkarim Moussa Ahmed: Manager of the Mechanical Maintenance Department at the station, endorsed by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Osama Suleiman Selim: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Stations Company for Electricity Generation and MPIS coordinator.
Issue an approved work permit; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, e.g. wearing a helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure the work area is defined and appropriate warning signs are posted.
Shut down the unit and put it in maintenance mode.
Occupational safety and health and personal protective equipment
Safety pin
Blade locking device
Close the unit inlet and outlet gates
Dewater and dry the unit
Open the runner inspection door
Open the guide vanes
Fit the Locking Device on the servomotor ("blade locking device")
Check the guide vane arms and change the safety pin if necessary
Check and measure the guide vane and runner clearances
Check the connections between the fixed parts
Inspect the runner hub gasket
Inspect the runner blades and the runner hub to ensure no cavitation has appeared
Inspect and check the maintenance rubber of the stuffing box
Inspect and check the operating rubber of the stuffing box
Carry out the inspection and cleaning works on the mechanical speed governor as per the main equipment outage programmes of the station
